name: Ribeye Steak, Grape Tomato & Mushroom Kebabs

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Wash and dry the parsley. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, whisk together the minced garlic, ½ of the minced parsley (save the rest for garnishing), olive oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 tbsp red wine vinegar
6 tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the steak into cubes; transfer to the bowl with the marinade and toss to coat.

Wash the tomatoes and mushrooms. Halve the mushrooms. Add the tomatoes and mushrooms to the marinade. Peel the onion and cut into chunks; add to the marinade. Toss beef and vegetables until well coated.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
0.341 kg white mushrooms
1 ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread the steak and vegetables onto 18 skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the steak and vegetable pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Add the kebabs (as many as will fit) to the grill or skillet. Cook until steak is browned and vegetables are tender, 3-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining kebabs.
To serve, place kebabs on a plate and sprinkle with the remaining minced parsley. Enjoy!
